description: This file is a Perl script that performs code quality checks, style enforcement, and patch validation for kernel or software source code, specifically adapted for OpenWrt. It handles reading source files or patches, interpreting diff patches, checking for coding standards, licenses, signatures, and other project-specific conventions.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays usage information and help for the script.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists all message types recognized by the script, parsed from source comments.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_file
methods.description: Seeds camel case identifiers from header or type definitions in a file for maintenance checks.

methods.name: is_maintained_obsolete
methods.description: Checks if a source file is marked as obsolete in the MAINTAINERS hierarchy.

methods.name: checklicenseline
methods.description: Flag used for license validity checks within the file processing logic.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a source or patch file, applying checks, parsing lines, and reporting issues.
